crossRefs.note: They traveled from Haradah, and encamped in Makheloth.

people.name: Haradah
people.line: A desert campsite during Israel's journey from Egypt.

people.name: Makheloth
people.line: A place where the Israelites camped in the wilderness

translations.web: They traveled from Haradah, and encamped in Makheloth.
translations.bsb: They set out from Haradah and camped at Makheloth.
translations.kjv: And they removed from Haradah, and pitched in Makheloth.
translations.asv: And they journeyed from Haradah, and encamped in Makheloth.
